checks: Native content build projection binds both source curves across T1..T5 (buff_bowenchanggui_HP and buff_bowenchanggui_shield, 0.10/0.12/0.14/0.16/0.18, bIsPercent=true), maps description placeholders by name ({0}->HP, {1}->shield) rather than DataList order, enforces ApplyGroupType FIVE against the wearer group, and retains the native description receipt.
Name-based parameter binding proven by mutating only the HP curve in a cloned table: hp_bonus follows the HP curve while shield_bonus stays on the shield curve.

Independent HP oracle (computed, not pinned by a point assertion): compiled HP = 22083 + 16483 * 1/10 = 237313/10 (rounded 23731), i.e. base-scaled addition, never hp_max * (1 + p); the Sakiri contract numbers (base ATK 620+474=1094, HP 16483->22083) are the reference.
Runtime damage parity: a scenario with the T1 YurenHp proc deals identical non-crit damage to a proc-less baseline (1000 ATK, 0 DEF/RES), proving the damage hook is a clean pass-through.
Validation rejects a foreign weapon id (fork_Whale) and cross-group (mint, group TWO) projection; a mutated bIsPercent unit hint is rejected.

Grant-time shield hypothesis is exercised through Adler Skill: exact threshold and live MaxHP denominator, additive outgoing ShieldEfficiency arithmetic, HP/live-buff snapshot persistence, and dead-source suppression.
projection.rs reports "runtime_execution_validated": false, honestly: shield-grant consumption is a modeled hypothesis exercised through synthetic callbacks, not executed native gameplay.
Focused run: 9/9 yuren tests pass (6 pre-existing + t5 gate + zero-MaxHP rejection + native self-grant settle). tools/cargo.py fmt --check clean on the touched test file.

Web scenario web/tests/combat/yuren.mjs is registered in web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs for CI and covers all five tiers at exactly-half and above-half HP, but WASM is not built in this Linux env, so the web test was not executed here.
combat_scope: Unconditional wearer HP percentage is projected in the compiled build HP-percent domain (compiled HP + native base HP * ratio), settled once. Frozen localized text says Rainman strengthens wearer shields above 50% HP, supporting wearer-only application. At an ordinary shield-grant callback, the T1..T5 shield-strength ratio joins the living equipped wearer's static and live ShieldEfficiency in the same outgoing shield_bonus sum only when current HP is strictly above half of live effective Max HP; exact 2*HP > MaxHP comparison is sampled at grant time and the settled capacity is fixed. Outgoing-zone addition and grant-time sampling are tested hypotheses; foreign-recipient grants reject explicitly. projection.rs reports runtime_execution_validated=false, honestly. Global release availability remains unverified.
independent_oracles: Lv1 Adler DEF1000 gives base 1800; T1 Rainman above half HP gives 1980 (1800*11/10), exactly-half HP500/Max1000 gives 1800, and HP501 gives 1980. (yuren_shield_bonus_uses_exact_living_grant_time_wearer_gate)

Static 0.2 + live 0.3 + Rainman 0.1 sum to 0.6, giving 1800*1.6 = 2880; later HP loss and live-bonus expiry preserve that settled capacity. (adler_rainman_shield_uses_additive_grant_snapshot_and_living_wearer)

At HP501 a live MaxHP bonus changing 1000 to 1200 disables Rainman, giving 1800*1.5 = 2700; at expiry MaxHP returns 1000, old capacity remains 2700, and a new self-grant with static 0.2 + Rainman 0.1 gives 1800*13/10 = 2340. (adler_rainman_shield_uses_additive_grant_snapshot_and_living_wearer)
T5 grant-time ratio is exactly 9/50 at HP501 and 0 at HP500; a zero effective Max HP rejects. (yuren_shield_bonus_t5_gate_is_exact, yuren_shield_bonus_rejects_zero_effective_max_hp)

Native self-grant settle with no other ShieldEfficiency: T1 at HP501 settles 1800*11/10 = 1980, T1 at HP500 settles 1800, T5 at HP501 settles 1800*59/50 = 2124. (yuren_native_self_grant_settles_with_grant_time_bonus)
known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.
Foreign-recipient shield grants remain unsupported under the frozen wearer-only wording; outgoing-zone addition and grant-time HP sampling remain explicit tested hypotheses.

Shields granted TO the Rainman wearer by other actors are not modeled at all: the shield formula has no recipient zone, so the frozen wearer-only wording for inbound grants from others has no tested interpretation.

tested_hypotheses: The {0} HP percentage applies in the compiled build HP-percent domain: compiled HP + native base HP * ratio, settled once to nearest integer, following the Eternal Waltz static precedent.
Parameter binding follows the description placeholder order ({0}=HP, {1}=shield) by parameter name, not the DataList order [shield, HP]; proven by a curve-mutation test.
Group FIVE legality: ElementData.ApplyGroupType must equal the wearer's CharacterGroupType or projection rejects; empty ExclusiveCharacterIDArray follows ApplyGroupType.

Frozen localized text says Rainman strengthens wearer shields above 50% HP, supporting wearer-only application. At an ordinary shield-grant callback, its ratio joins static and live outgoing ShieldEfficiency additively only when exact 2*currentHP > live effective MaxHP; sampling at grant time and outgoing-zone addition are tested hypotheses, and later HP/bonus changes do not rescale settled capacity. Foreign-recipient behavior rejects explicitly.
